title: Alexander the second
summary: Raleigh names Alexander the second in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Alexander the second, sonne of Amyntas and Eurydice, who raigned not much aboue one yeere. He is not Alexander the Great, and not Alexander son of Amintas. The one-word title would fold onto those records, so the title is three words. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.
